glyph_groups.exception_failed_on: criterion 4 — the only cue is a thin story ring around the small photo, a product convention a first-time user does not know; and criterion 3 is weak because the photo and the name look like one control
glyph_groups.evidence: all 8 tapped across the five live chats. For Deki, Fra Mendy and Marco Peralta the whole header (photo + name) opens 'Thread details'. For Krishna Bharti and Siquem Lsm, who have a live story, pressing the small photo opens that person's full-screen STORY, while pressing the name beside it opens 'Thread details'. The same-looking header therefore does two different jobs depending on whose chat it is and where exactly the finger lands. The captures of Deki's header (screen10-f2, screen17-f2) show an empty white slot where the photo goes; on the live app the photo draws in full — a capture artifact, given no weight.
glyph_groups.recommendation: keep the whole header on one job (Thread details) and offer the story through a separate, labelled entry (e.g. a 'View story' item), or make the photo always open the story only when a clearly visible, labelled ring is present
